blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Nearly 4,000 human remains at the city’s public Catholic cemetery, El Reposo, have yet to be retrieved by their families despite appeals by the local Catholic Church and the city government to transfer them to other burial grounds ahead of the cemetery’s planned rehabilitation. The city government and the local Catholic Church issued an advisory in 2023 prohibiting further burials at El Reposo to pave the way for its rehabilitation. City government records showed that more than 12,500 people had been buried at the cemetery. Of this number, over 8,000 remains have already been retrieved and transferred by […]...
